actionable_pitch.primary: Skila AI can significantly enhance DPS Siddipet’s STEM and AI adoption by integrating AI-driven personalized learning modules for students across grades 6-12. Given their existing use of Lego Robotics and Google Classroom, Skila AI’s adaptive learning platform can complement their current tech stack by offering AI-powered tutoring, automated assessments, and data-driven insights for teachers.
actionable_pitch.secondary: Propose a pilot for grades 9-12 focusing on AI-driven math and science tutoring. Highlight Skila AI’s alignment with CBSE’s digital education initiatives and its ability to reduce teacher workload through automated grading and progress tracking.
value_proposition: AI-powered adaptive learning for personalized student pathways.
Seamless integration with existing ERP (Fedena) and LMS (Google Classroom).
STEM-focused AI tools for robotics and coding curriculum enhancement.
Data analytics dashboard for principals/teachers to monitor student performance trends.
Parent engagement features to sync with their existing parent portal.

recommendations.initial_contact: Schedule a virtual demo focusing on AI in STEM education, emphasizing how Skila AI can bridge gaps in their current robotics and coding programs. Use case studies from other CBSE schools in Telangana/Andhra Pradesh.
recommendations.follow_up: Arrange a site visit to discuss pilot implementation logistics (e.g., device requirements, teacher training). Offer a 3-month pilot for one section per grade (9-12) with measurable KPIs (e.g., 20% improvement in math/science scores).
recommendations.long_term: Post-pilot, propose full-school adoption with phased rollout (grades 6-8 in Year 2, grades 3-5 in Year 3). Bundle Skila AI with professional development workshops for teachers on AI integration.
recommendations.competitive_edge: Position Skila AI as a ‘CBSE-aligned digital transformation partner’ to differentiate from generic EdTech providers. Leverage Skila AI’s NLP capabilities for multilingual support (Telugu/English/Hindi) to cater to regional students.

objection_handling.budget: Propose a subscription model with tiered pricing (e.g., ₹500/student/year for basic, ₹800/student/year for premium). Highlight cost savings via reduced need for additional STEM teachers.
objection_handling.tech_integration: Offer a dedicated onboarding team to ensure zero-downtime integration with Fedena and Google Classroom. Provide a 1-week training session for IT staff.
objection_handling.resistance_to_change: Share testimonials from similar schools (e.g., DPS Noida, Hyderabad Public School) that adopted Skila AI. Emphasize how AI augments—not replaces—teachers’ roles.
